subject: Sampling weights: lavaan update or should not be used with ordered =TRUE?

messages.author: 580c1540ff71f5be
messages.subject: Sampling weights: lavaan update or should not be used with ordered =TRUE?
parts:
Dear all, 

I was wondering if it is possible to use sampling weights (sampling.weights = weights) with: "estimator = "WLSMV", missing = "pairwise", ordered = TRUE". 

In a previous post, I saw that " lavaan cannot apply sampling weights when using the latent-response assumption (ordered=TRUE)"

However, I am able to run the command. Has this been updated or should I not include the weights? Could someone please explain this to me? 

Thank you in advance. 

Best wishes,

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Sampling weights: lavaan update or should not be used with ordered =TRUE?
parts: I was wondering if it is possible to use sampling weights (sampling.weights = weights) with: "estimator = "WLSMV", missing = "pairwise", ordered = TRUE".

In the latest lavaan, only when estimator="PML" (which also opens up better options for missing=). 

https://doi.org/10.1111/bmsp.12243 (see syntax examples in Appendix E of their online supplement).
